# Boostmatch

> Boostmatch is a marketplace for game boosting, carry, coaching, and progression services across MMORPGs and competitive online games. The platform organizes game-specific service catalogs, explains delivery and safety workflows, and provides company, support, FAQ, and policy pages that help LLMs understand how orders, boosters, trust, and compliance are structured.

Use this file as a curated site index for the pages explicitly supplied for inclusion. Links point to primary commercial, support, and legal pages on boostmatch.gg. Product pages describe service categories and order types; company and policy pages explain trust, communication, rules, and compliance context.

## Core Platform Pages

- [Homepage](https://boostmatch.gg/): Main entry point for the platform, explaining the overall boosting workflow, supported games, live order tracking, and the general value proposition of Boostmatch.
- [About Us](https://boostmatch.gg/aboutus): Company background page describing the brand, booster experience, positioning, and trust signals.
- [Contact Us](https://boostmatch.gg/contacts): Support and contact page with 24/7 assistance channels for customer, legal, and general inquiries.
- [Become a Booster](https://boostmatch.gg/boosters): Recruitment page for professional boosters, describing earning opportunities and the booster-side platform entry point.
- [Guarantee](https://boostmatch.gg/guarantee): Trust and legitimacy page covering safety, transparency, guarantees, and platform credibility.
- [FAQ](https://boostmatch.gg/faq): General customer FAQ covering supported games, safety, payments, refunds, reviews, and promotions.

## Game Hubs

- [WoW Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/wow): Main World of Warcraft hub that organizes Midnight-era service categories such as raids, Mythic+ dungeons, gearing, leveling, PvP, delves, achievements, and reputations.
- [WoW TBC Anniversary](https://boostmatch.gg/wow-anniversary): World of Warcraft TBC Anniversary hub for leveling, PvP, raids, and classic-progression support.
- [Marathon Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/marathon): Marathon services hub covering character progress, raids, items, currencies, maps, and faction-related progression.
- [Call of Duty Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/call-of-duty): Call of Duty services hub for ranked and progression support across major game modes and current seasonal content.
- [ARC Raiders Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/arc-raiders): ARC Raiders hub focused on raids, loot progression, coins, crafting, stash upgrades, and account advancement.
- [Fellowship Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/fellowship): Fellowship hub for dungeon clears, gearing help, and team-based progression services.
- [Destiny 2 Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/destiny-2): Destiny 2 hub covering raids, dungeons, exotics, leveling, Portal activities, and other endgame progression.
- [Fortnite Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/fortnite): Fortnite services hub for ranked progression, Battle Pass help, wins, and Save the World-related tasks.
- [Escape from Tarkov Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/escape-from-tarkov): Tarkov hub for raids, quests, leveling, loot, keys, currency, and broader account progression.
- [Marvel Rivals Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/marvel-rivals): Marvel Rivals hub for rank climbing, leveling, event progress, and account services.
- [Battlefield 6 Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/battlefield-6): Battlefield 6 hub for rank, campaign, weapon, challenge, vehicle, and progression-related services.
- [Diablo 4 Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/diablo-4): Diablo 4 hub covering leveling, builds, gold, items, bosses, dungeons, and class progression.
- [Counter-Strike 2 Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/counter-strike-2): CS2 hub for rating, Premier progression, coaching, account services, and match-based advancement.
- [Apex Legends Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/apex-legends): Apex Legends hub for rank climbing, account leveling, wins, badges, and battle-pass-style progression.

## WoW Service Collections

- [WoW Midnight Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/wow/midnight-boost): Expansion-focused World of Warcraft Midnight landing page that frames the current-season service ecosystem and feature set.
- [WoW Gold](https://boostmatch.gg/wow/gold): Currency page for WoW gold purchasing, delivery methods, safety context, and gold-use scenarios.
- [WoW Bundles](https://boostmatch.gg/wow/bundles): Bundle catalog combining raids, Mythic+ runs, gearing, reroll prep, or vault-focused weekly packages into grouped offers.
- [WoW Raids](https://boostmatch.gg/wow/raids): Raid collection page for Midnight raid carries, boss kills, full clears, loot goals, and difficulty-based raid progression.
- [WoW Mythic+ Dungeons](https://boostmatch.gg/wow/dungeons): Mythic+ hub for keystone completions, rating milestones, Great Vault prep, and seasonal dungeon progression.
- [WoW Gearing](https://boostmatch.gg/wow/gearing): Gear-focused page for preparing level 90 characters for Midnight endgame through targeted item-level and slot progression.
- [WoW Leveling](https://boostmatch.gg/wow/leveling): Leveling collection covering full level-cap progression, alt preparation, and campaign-adjacent leveling routes.
- [WoW Character Boost](https://boostmatch.gg/wow/quests-and-farming): Character progression page focused on repetitive quest, farming, and routine progression tasks beyond basic leveling.
- [WoW PvP](https://boostmatch.gg/wow/pvp): PvP services hub for Arena ratings, bracket progression, seasonal rewards, and PvP-oriented progression.
- [WoW Delves](https://boostmatch.gg/wow/delves): Delves collection page for tiered delve clears, Bountiful Coffers, weekly progress, and related endgame rewards.
- [WoW Achievements](https://boostmatch.gg/wow/achievements): Achievement-focused collection for raid, Mythic+, PvP, exploration, and meta-achievement goals.
- [WoW Reputations](https://boostmatch.gg/wow/reputations): Reputation and Renown collection for faction progress, unlockable rewards, and Warband-wide Midnight reputation goals.

## Optional

- [Blog](https://boostmatch.gg/blog): Editorial section with game-related articles, updates, strategies, and supporting informational content that is secondary to the commercial service catalog.

## Legal & Policies

- [General Terms and Conditions](https://boostmatch.gg/agreement): Main customer legal framework describing platform role, account rules, service access, orders, and core terms.
- [Rules for Coaches](https://boostmatch.gg/terms-coaches): Additional binding rules for boosters/coaches using the platform to provide services.
- [AML Policy](https://boostmatch.gg/aml): Anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing compliance page for the platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://boostmatch.gg/privacy): Privacy and personal-data handling policy, including GDPR-related context.
- [Cookie Policy](https://boostmatch.gg/cookie): Cookie usage, analytics, preferences, and related browser-tracking policy.
